The '''Harmonious Habitat''' was the name given to the cave that linked the northern side of the [[Quadrilateral Forum]] to the [[Xenoform Marshes]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Harmonious Habitat first appears in the Operation "Terror From Beyond" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=operation|Terror From Beyond}}</ref>
